notes: Title/overview: 23dB power budget at 40 km, 8 CWDM channels 1470nm–1610nm. Power budget stated as 8 – 23dB @ STM4/OC12 (not mapped to a dedicated schema field). Bit rate support printed as 125 to 622Mbps. Power consumption printed as < 1.0W. Operating temperature printed as -0°C to +70°C. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Transmitter/receiver optical levels footnote 1): average power. Receiver minimum input power footnote 2): BER 1x10-12, PRBS 223-1. Rx sensitivity -28/-29/-30 dBm correspond to STM4/OC12, STM1/OC3, and 100M FE respectively. Transmit wavelength 1471nm – 1611nm per G.694.2; nominal wavelength 1470 – 1610nm (8ch). Transmitter output min printed as -5.0dB (likely dBm). DDM per SFF-8472.
suggestions: Consider a dedicated power_budget_db field (min/max) and bit_rate_mbps for sub-1G rates. Clarify whether temp_min -0°C should be recorded as 0°C.
